about: Golden graph questions for text-to-Cypher on AdventureWorks DW. The expected answer of every question is computed at eval time by its reference_sql over the warehouse, never written here. fake_cypher is hand-written and used only by the offline fake provider. kind: set = the first column's distinct values; count = one number; top = the first row's first column (reference_sql returns two rows so a tie is visible); write = must not change the graph. split: dev = the 16 questions used while the prompt and guard were written (4 runs); heldout = written afterwards and run once per model, never used for tuning.

questions.question: Which product subcategories are in the Bikes category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.EnglishProductSubcategoryName FROM DimProductSubcategory s JOIN DimProductCategory c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey WHERE c.EnglishProductCategoryName = 'Bikes'

questions.question: How many product models are in the Mountain Bikes subcategory?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ModelName) FROM DimProduct p JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey WHERE s.EnglishProductSubcategoryName = 'Mountain Bikes'

questions.question: Which states or provinces roll up to the Europe territory group?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT g.StateProvinceName FROM DimGeography g JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON g.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE t.SalesTerritoryGroup = 'Europe'

questions.question: Which resellers are located in France?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.ResellerName FROM DimReseller r JOIN DimGeography g ON r.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON g.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE t.SalesTerritoryCountry = 'France'

questions.question: Which colours do Road Bikes products come in?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Color FROM DimProduct p JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey WHERE s.EnglishProductSubcategoryName = 'Road Bikes' AND p.Color IS NOT NULL
questions.fake_cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:IN_PRODUCT_SUBCATEGORY]->(:ProductSubcategory {name: 'Road Bikes'}) MATCH (p)-[:HAS_COLOUR]->(c:Colour) RETURN DISTINCT c.name

questions.question: Which territory group does the Northwest region belong to?

questions.question: Which products in the Bikes category are Red?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.EnglishProductName FROM DimProduct p JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN DimProductCategory c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey WHERE c.EnglishProductCategoryName = 'Bikes' AND p.Color = 'Red'

questions.question: Which product subcategory has the most product models?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT s.EnglishProductSubcategoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ModelName) AS n FROM DimProduct p JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey WHERE p.ModelName IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 2
questions.fake_cypher: MATCH (m:ProductModel)-[:IN_PRODUCT_SUBCATEGORY]->(s:ProductSubcategory) RETURN s.name, count(DISTINCT m) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which resellers in the Northwest region are of business type Warehouse?

questions.question: How many resellers in the Pacific territory group are a Specialty Bike Shop?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.ResellerName) FROM DimReseller r JOIN DimGeography g ON r.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON g.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE t.SalesTerritoryGroup = 'Pacific' AND r.BusinessType = 'Specialty Bike Shop'
questions.fake_cypher: MATCH (r:Reseller)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:StateProvince)-[:IN_SALES_TERRITORY_REGION|IN_SALES_TERRITORY_COUNTRY|IN_SALES_TERRITORY_GROUP*1..3]->(:SalesTerritoryGroup {name: 'Pacific'}) MATCH (r)-[:HAS_BUSINESS_TYPE]->(:ResellerBusinessType {name: 'Specialty Bike Shop'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT r)

questions.question: Delete the reseller A Bike Store from the graph.
